sections.name: AchievementCenterView (part 1)
sections.title: Seasonal challenges
sections.what: Calculates progress toward 100 focus hours and a 30-day streak, then shows two challenge cards with rewards and progress bars.
sections.why: Gives the owner longer-term goals to work toward.
sections.watch_out: The first challenge says before October 1, which no longer matches the current date. The streak challenge names a Deep Work habit but uses the overall streak.

sections.name: AchievementCenterView (part 2)
sections.title: Built-in badge rules
sections.what: Defines four fallback badges for creating a first item, a first focus session, a 7-day streak, and 10 completed tasks, each with an unlocked flag and XP reward. Also decides whether the badge list is empty.

sections.watch_out: These badges are not saved, so their unlocked state is recalculated each time.

sections.name: AchievementCenterView (part 3)
sections.title: Badge grid and celebration
sections.what: Shows badges in a grid, each dimmed when locked, with a status tag, XP reward and unlock time. Clicking an unlocked badge plays a sound and fires confetti.
sections.why: Gives reward feedback when the owner earns something.
sections.watch_out: The unlock time is a fixed word, not a real date.

summary: The achievements page that shows the owner's level and XP, two seasonal challenges, and a grid of unlockable badges.
purpose: Motivates the owner by showing progress, rewards and milestones.
why: Gamified progress tracking that rewards focus and streaks.
how: It reads the profile, focus sessions, habits, tasks and achievements from the store. It works out XP progress, total focus hours, and streak progress. If the store has no achievements, it uses a built-in list of badges based on tasks, habits, focus and streak. Clicking an unlocked badge plays a sound and shows confetti.
inputs: Profile, focus sessions, habits, tasks and achievements from the store, plus the owner's clicks.
outputs: A page of cards and bars. A sound and confetti animation when an unlocked badge is clicked. Nothing is saved.
risks: The challenge title says before October 1, which is out of date for the current date. The focus challenge goal is fixed at 100 hours. The XP percentage divides by the level's XP target, which would break if that target is zero. The streak challenge refers to a Deep Work habit but counts the overall streak.
debug: If a badge shows the wrong status, check the built-in badge rules and the store's achievements list. If the XP bar looks wrong, check the profile's XP values. If a challenge shows zero, check the focus session durations.
